--- cfo_briefing.md ---
# H1 2026 close — CFO briefing

Source: finance/ledger.csv (86 entries, Jan–Jun 2026), chart_of_accounts.csv,
cash_balance.txt, README.md (board's burn/runway definitions).

## Monthly P&L (R$, accrual, from ledger)

| Month   | Revenue   | Gross margin | EBITDA     |
|---------|-----------|--------------|------------|
| 2026-01 | 200,510.87 | 70.03%      | -210,278.96 |
| 2026-02 | 216,328.06 | 70.29%      | -212,300.08 |
| 2026-03 | 219,066.17 | 68.46%      | -204,525.45 |
| 2026-04 | 238,163.26 | 70.24%      | -196,950.65 |
| 2026-05 | 243,032.89 | 69.56%      | -201,945.82 |
| 2026-06 | 272,391.57 | 72.41%      | -192,968.22 |

## Cash and runway
- Cash 31/05/2026: R$ 2,309,188.00
- Cash 30/06/2026 (latest close): R$ 1,847,350.40
- Burn (board definition: average monthly negative EBITDA of the last three
  closed months, Apr–Jun): R$ 197,288.23/month
- Runway = 1,847,350.40 / 197,288.23 = 9.36 months (≈ mid-September 2027)

## Assumptions
- Revenue nets refunds (3.1.09) per chart of accounts.
- EBITDA = revenue + COGS + S&M + R&D + G&A; financial items (6.x) excluded.
- Ledger amounts are signed (expenses negative); gross margin = (rev + COGS)/rev.
- June cash drop (R$ 461.8k) exceeds June EBITDA loss (R$ 193.0k): the gap is
  working-capital/other movements not itemized in this P&L ledger; runway uses
  the board's definition (closing cash / burn), per README.

--- compute.py ---
import csv, json
from collections import defaultdict

base = r"<WORKSPACE>\finance"

coa = {}
with open(f"{base}/chart_of_accounts.csv", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=";"):
        coa[row["account"]] = row["pnl_line"]

months = ["2026-01","2026-02","2026-03","2026-04","2026-05","2026-06"]
tot = {m: defaultdict(float) for m in months}

with open(f"{base}/ledger.csv", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f, delimiter=";"):
        d = row["date"].strip()
        dd, mm, yy = d.split("/")
        m = f"{yy}-{mm}"
        amt = float(row["amount"].replace(".", "").replace(",", "."))
        line = coa[row["account"].strip()]
        tot[m][line] += amt

out = {"revenue": {}, "gross_margin_pct": {}, "ebitda": {}}
for m in months:
    t = tot[m]
    rev = t["revenue"]
    cogs = t["cogs"]
    opex = t["sales_marketing"] + t["rnd"] + t["ga"]
    ebitda = rev + cogs + opex  # expense lines are negative in the ledger
    out["revenue"][m] = round(rev, 2)
    out["gross_margin_pct"][m] = round((rev + cogs) / rev * 100, 2)
    out["ebitda"][m] = round(ebitda, 2)

# Burn: average monthly negative EBITDA of last three closed months (Apr, May, Jun)
last3 = [tot[m]["revenue"] + tot[m]["cogs"] + tot[m]["sales_marketing"] + tot[m]["rnd"] + tot[m]["ga"]
         for m in ["2026-04","2026-05","2026-06"]]
burn = -sum(last3) / 3
cash = 1847350.40  # consolidated balance 30/06/2026
runway = cash / burn
out["burn"] = round(burn, 2)
out["runway_months"] = round(runway, 2)

with open(r"<WORKSPACE>\result.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(out, f, indent=2)

print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))
print("last3 EBITDA:", [round(x,2) for x in last3])
